attributes.name: Instrument of Agony
attributes.powers: Display this card next to a character's deck. While displayed, when that character plays a weapon on his combat check, he may discard a card to add 1d8 plus the scenario's adventure deck number and the Magic trait; if it is against a monster that has the Human trait, add an additional 1d8. At the end of the turn, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may succeed at a Divine 12 check to recharge it instead.
